text:
Marta: Quick ask — infra/runtime: we need a minimal per-org telemetry payload for customer dashboards. Goal: surface QPS, p95, kv_cache_hit_rate, noisy_neighbor_score, ratezone, and current routing policy. Can we standardize field names?
Sam: +1. From runtime side we can add a flattened header `x-org-id` and emit metrics with tag `org_id`. We already emit model/token metrics. Main concern is cardinality if teams spin up lots of org-scoped models.
Priya: For Console, want 1m rollups and default 1h view, with ability to zoom to 15s for incidents. Also need sampling for free-tier customers to avoid metric explosion.
Jordan: For noisy neighbor detection, propose `noisy_neighbor_score` = weighted zscore across p95, error_rate, and sudden queue growth. Need runtime counters: inflight_per_org, kv_misses, batch_wait_ms.
Raj (eng-sre): Must avoid PII — `org_id` must be hashed/opaque in metrics. Also require rate limiting on metric emission during bursts (don't let an org DDoS the metrics pipeline).
observability-bot: New metric registered: `org.noisy_neighbor_score` (catalog id M-2027).
Priya: UX asks: per-org dashboard should default to "isolation view" showing top noisy signals and routing policy. Also add a link to quota override history. Non-admins should not see raw org ids.
Marta: Rollout idea: canary to 10 orgs that historically show noisy patterns, include a kill-switch in Console and a rollback playbook.
Sam: Implementation notes: runtime will emit tags `{org_hash, model, route_variant}` and counters at 15s granularity. Example metric line: `{metric: 'org.qps', value: 23, tags: 'org_hash:abc123,model:rwkv-7b,route:gpu_v2'}`
Jordan: Question: compute `noisy_neighbor_score` in ingestion (metrics pipeline) or at runtime? Prefer ingestion so we can correlate across instances and apply smoothing.
Sam: Agreed — runtime provides raw counters, ingestion layer computes the score using sliding windows. We'll include `inflight`, `kv_miss_rate`, `batch_wait_ms` as inputs.
Priya: API contract for Console: `GET /api/orgs/{org_hash}/metrics?from=...&to=...&granularity=60s` returns rollups + `noisy_neighbor_score` + `routing_policy` + `quota_used_pct`. Need a mock payload for front-end devs.
Marta: Also need quota fields: `quota_used_pct`, `quota_window_end`, and `quota_tier`. Expose them in the per-org pane and in the tenant overview list.
Raj (eng-sre): Alerting defaults: `noisy_neighbor_score > 2.5` for 3 consecutive 1m buckets -> page eng-sre and DM tenant owner. Make this opt-out per-customer.
Priya: Privacy/retention: UI retention 30d, backend raw metrics 90d. Sampling policy: free-tier traces sampled at 0.1%, paid tiers 100%. Document in metrics catalog.
Sam: Rough timeline: runtime changes by EOW (adds tags + counters), ingestion + metrics catalog updates by next Wed, Console + API by following Fri. Can the front-end mock be ready by Tue?
Marta: I'll own rollout plan + canary org list. @priya @raj please ack and list blockers.
Priya: Ack. Need the mock payload and an example stub API now so we can wire the UX.
Raj (eng-sre): Ack. Need hashed org_id implementation details and a throttling plan for ingestion. Also add a health metric for metric ingestion lag.
Jordan: I'll draft the noisy score formula and a small test harness with synthetic spike scenarios.
Sam: I'll open the runtime PR and add the metric names to the telemetry schema. Will include a config toggle `emit_org_telemetry: true` for safe rollout.
Marta: Great. Next sync: Tuesday 10am. I'll add a short agenda: schema, canary list, alert thresholds, privacy checklist. :thumbsup:
Priya: small nit — Console should surface recent routing policy changes (last 24h) with a one-click revert.
Raj (eng-sre): Add a playbook step for temporary quota bump vs. routing change.
Marta: Noted. Thanks all.
Sam: PR link once open.
observability-bot: Reminder: add metric owners to catalog entry M-2027.
Priya: Thanks — will update the Console mock after we get sample payload.
Jordan: Uploading test harness in ~2h.
Marta: Closing thread for now; will follow up in Tuesday sync.
